snippet.title: Mario kart Black "Custom"
snippet.description:
_____________CUSTOM TRACKS:_____________
Normal Track names = File name // Author's Course Name (Author) = Custom Music

~Mushroom Cup~
Luigi Circuit = beginner_course.szs // Luigi's Volcano Raceway (Mr Bean) = Cake - The Distance
Moo Moo Meadows = farm_course.szs // Autumn Meadows (Roobix & Atlantian) = Pogo - Alice
Mushroom George = kinoko_course.szs // Humongous Fungus (DarkyBenji)  = RJD2 - 1976
Toads Factory = factory_course.szs // Coke Factory (ricd61har) = Cherry Poppin' Daddies - Zuit Suit Riot

~Flower Cup~
Mario Circuit = castle_course.szs // Fractal Dreams (Roobix) = Cake - The Distance (forced to use same song as Luigi Circuit by game programming)
Coconut Mall = shopping_course.szs // Gallery Mall (Atlantian) = Colin James - Triple Shot
DK's Snowboard Cross = boardcross_course.szs // Negative Snowboard Cross (L@R$) = Ice Cube - Today Was a Good Day
Wario's Gold Mine = truck_course.szs // Wario's Space Mine (Mr Bean) = The Upbeats feat. Kemo - Carousel

~Star Cup~
Daisy Circuit = senior_course.szs // Casino Park (DarkyBenji) = Koop - The Moonbounce
Koopa Cape = water_course.szs // Icy Kape (ricd61har, edited by Roobix) =  Fanu - Painajaisista-Todellisuuteen
Maple Treeway = treehouse_course.szs // Darkview Treeway (UgotHacked) = D. Kay - Interlude
Grumble Volcano = volcano_course.szs // Hellish Volcano (Roobix) = CkY - Hellions on Parade

~Special Cup~
Dry Dry Ruins = desert_course.szs // Cleo's Temple (KO Teknik and Houbi) = Milk & Sugar pres. MS2 - Stay Around (Dj Delicious & Till West Remix)
Moonview Highway = ridgehighway_course.szs // Moonside Highway (SPARTA!) = Petula Clark - Downtown
Bowser's Castle = koopa_course.szs // Bowser's Steel Flame Castle (Alex) = Don Rimini - Hools
Rainbow Road = rainbow_course.szs // Darky Road v2 (DarkyBenji) = Joker - Tron (VIP Mix)

~Shell Cup~
GCN Peach Beach = old_peach_gc.szs // BP's Big Disaster (Roobix) = Calyx - Dead Ringer
DS Yoshi Falls = old_falls_ds.szs // Disco Falls (GrapesLuvsnhotspot) = MillionYoung - Hammock
SNES Ghost Valley = old_obake_sfc.szs // SNES Tetris Valley (ARM1) = Covox - Dubslide
N64 Mario Raceway = old_mario_64.szs // N64 Mario's Neon Raceway (KoopaTroop) = Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Solly Remix)

~Banana Cup~
N64 Sherbet Land = old_sherbet_64.szs // RedIce (Ozelot) = Cookie Monsta - Optimus Prime
GBA Shy Guy Beach = old_heyho_gba.szs // Flame Beach (Maurice) = Sharps - Yuck Beats
DS Delfino Square = old_town_ds.szs // Foursquare (DarkyBenji) = Ronald Jenkees - Throwing Fire
GCN Waluigi Stadium = old_waluigi_gc.szs // Siicky Stoned Waluigi Stadium (Siick) = The Bloody Beetroots - Butter

~Leaf Cup~
DS Desert Hills = old_desert_ds.szs // Paradize's Désert V2 (Coralia) = MF Doom - Camphor
GBA Bowser Castle = old_koopa_gba.szs // Bowser's Motor Way (Lol-Alex) = Super Dub Bros. - Mario Is Dead
N64 DK's Jungle Parkway = old_donkey_64.szs // Frozen Canadian Trails (Roobix) = Classified - Oh Canada!
GCN Mario Circuit = old_mario_gc.szs // Luigi Mansion (DarkyBenji) = Brainbug - Nightmare

~Lighting Cup~
SNES Mario Circuit 3 = old_mario_sfc.szs // Roo's Rollin Raceway (Roobix) =  Tapes - Hackney Dub
DS Peach Gardens = old_garden_ds.szs // Space Gardens (Roobix) = Beastie Boys - Intergalactic
NGC DK Mountain = old_donkey_gc.szs // Red Mountain (DarkyBenji) = MGMT - Time to Pretend
N64 Bowser's Castle = old_koopa_64.szs // Crazy Castle (NinCheat) = System of a Down - Sugar

~Battle Tracks~
Block Battle = block_battle.szs - Turbo Pads Everywhere! (?) = Muse - Knights of Cydonia (Nostalgia Dubstep Remix)

Extra stuff
Losing Music & No Trophy For You!: Avenue Q - Schadenfreude
Normal Ending: Moderat & Modeselektor - Art Cash SBTKRB Remix
Winning Ending: Final Fantasy Victory Fanfare (From FFVII)
Winning Tropy Presentation: Queen - We Are The Champions
Course Preview Intro: exerpt from Pendulum - Genesis
License Options: Plan B - She Said (16 Bit Remix)
WiFi Waiting Music: Jeopardy Thinking Theme
Game Credits: M83 - We Own The Sky (Udachi Remix)
